mechanism: A single violent upward pulse on 2026-08-05 threw the body from 8.00 to 10.30 in one session; for two weeks the field held that level without extending it, displacement alternating while the pulse was absorbed. On the final session resistance rose monotonically through the day (0.477 to 0.601) as the body pushed to 11.01 and was refused, and at the close a channel died — the only death of the day — leaving a dead-channel URF=0.000 reading and dragging stability to its lowest of the whole month (0.802, versus 0.87-0.93 during the plateau). The pulse's stored tension is spent and the first structural crack has arrived at the top of the move; the field should relax back toward the pre-pulse shelf.
